Every role at Orsini moves a patient closer to life-changing therapy. We partner with biopharma innovators, healthcare providers, and payers to make access simple, compassionate, and reliable - so no patient is left behind. Make your next role matter.

About Orsini

Providing compassionate care since 1987, Orsini is a leader in rare disease and gene therapy pharmacy solutions, built to simplify how patients connect to advanced medicines. Through our comprehensive commercialization solutions including a nationwide specialty pharmacy, patient services hub, home infusion and nursing network, and third-party logistics provider, we work with biopharma, providers, and payors to ensure No Patient is Left Behind™.

OUR MISSION

Orsini is on a mission to be the essential partner for biopharma innovators, healthcare providers, and payers to support patients and their families in accessing revolutionary treatments for rare diseases. Through our integrated portfolio of services, we seek to pioneer comprehensive solutions that simplify how patients connect to advanced therapies while providing holistic, compassionate care so that No Patient is Left Behind™.

CORE VALUES

At the heart of our company culture, the Orsini LIVE IT Core Values serve as guiding principles that shape how we interact with each other and those we serve. These values are the driving force behind our commitment to excellence, collaboration, and genuine care in every aspect of our work.

Compensation

The salary range for this position is $99,000 - $111,000 per year.

The actual compensation will be determined based on geographic location and other job-related factors

LOCATION

This position is remote; however, the ideal candidate will be located within proximity to one of our office locations in Elk Grove Village, IL or Columbus, OH.

Estimated travel requirement is <40% of the time for manufacturer meetings, launch planning sessions, Quarterly Business Reviews, implementation working sessions, and other business engagements as needed.

Position Summary

This role plays a central role in the implementation and launch of new rare disease programs at Orsini. This position serves as the leader responsible for overseeing all aspects of rare disease specialty pharmacy program launches from the point of contract win through the stabilization period following a successful go-live at PDUFA. This role owns end-to-end manufacturer onboarding and implementation activities for pharmaceutical products, patient support programs, and manufacturer partnerships.

The Launch & Implementation Manager serves as the primary manufacturer contact throughout implementation while partnering with internal stakeholders across Clinical Operations, Pharmacy Operations, Patient Services, Trade Relations, Information Technology, Compliance, Quality, Finance, and Data Analytics to ensure flawless, on-time, and compliant launch execution.

This role is accountable for launch readiness, project governance, KPI achievement, timeline management, risk mitigation, issue escalation, operational performance, and ongoing manufacturer satisfaction. The ideal candidate brings strong specialty pharmacy operational expertise, project management rigor, client-facing experience, and the ability to lead multiple concurrent launch initiatives supporting rare disease, high-cost, complex, and newly launched specialty therapies. This position requires periodic travel for manufacturer meetings, implementation planning sessions, in-person working sessions, and other business engagements as needed.

Lead and manage end-to-end implementation strategy and activities for new specialty pharmacy programs, pharmaceutical manufacturer partnerships, and product launches.

Responsible for project planning, launch governance, timeline management, risk mitigation, issue escalation, and post-launch stabilization.
Serve as the primary manufacturer contact during implementation, address client needs and updates, resolve issues, provide guidance and recommendations, and proactively raise risks and improvement opportunities

Facilitate launch meetings, implementation reviews, issue resolution, and stakeholder communications.

Act as the primary project owner and launch subject matter expert across internal cross-functional teams.
Manage multiple concurrent client implementation projects while ensuring adherence to timelines, milestones, contractual obligations, launch readiness requirements, and manufacturer expectations.

Lead recurring cross-functional meetings.

Engage Clinical Operations, Pharmacy Operations, Patient Services, Trade Relations, Information Technology, Compliance, Quality, Finance, and Data Analytics teams.
Champion accountability, operational excellence, and cross-functional alignment across all workstreams.

Develop and maintain launch documentation and operational requirements.

Develop and maintain business rules, workflows, SOPs, implementation documentation, and operational requirements to support successful program launches and ongoing program management.
Partner with leadership to refine and standardize implementation methodologies, tools, and best practices.

Drive clinical and operational readiness activities.

Coordinate staff training, workflow validation, process testing, launch assessments, and operational preparedness reviews.
Ensure launch teams are prepared to execute program requirements at go-live.

Coordinate specialty pharmacy, hub, REMS, cold-chain, reporting, and program deliverables.

Coordinate implementation and alignment of SP/Hub Services, REMS programs, cold-chain distribution requirements, manufacturer reporting requirements, patient support services, and specialty pharmacy program deliverables.
Align program deliverables with manufacturer expectations and internal operational capabilities.

Track KPIs, implementation milestones, operational performance metrics, contractual deliverables, and reporting obligations.

Monitor key launch performance indicators and timeline adherence.
Support reporting obligations and operational performance visibility.

Lead post-launch reviews and continuous improvement initiatives cross-functionally.

Develop ongoing process improvement opportunities for Implementation and partner departments.
Contribute feedback to drive implementation efficiency and increase standardization across launches.
Perform other duties or projects as assigned.

Strong specialty pharmacy operational understanding, including intake, enrollment, reimbursement support, dispense workflows, manufacturer trade relationships, patient services, and commercialization processes.
Working knowledge of CareTend and its role in specialty pharmacy operations.
Knowledge of REMS programs, cold-chain distribution requirements, specialty pharmacy reporting, and limited distribution networks.
Exceptional project management, stakeholder management, communication, organizational, analytical, and executive-facing skills.
Ability to manage multiple concurrent implementation projects and competing priorities while proactively identifying risks, issues, and operational improvement opportunities.
Experience developing operational workflows, business rules, SOPs, and implementation documentation.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Visio., as well as familiarity with AI tools such as Claude or Copilot and project management software.

PMP or equivalent project management certification preferred

Minimum of five (5) years of related work experience, at least four (4) years of experience in Specialty Pharmacy, Clinical Operations, or Patient Services.
Demonstrated experience managing implementation projects, operational readiness initiatives, or pharmaceutical product launches.
Experience supporting rare disease, high-cost therapies, biologics, gene therapies, cell therapies, or newly launched specialty pharmaceutical products preferred. Experience with Hub Services is preferred but not required.

At MMPA, commitment to milk quality begins on the farm and extends through five processing facilities and wholly owned subsidiary brands, Superior Dairy and Heritage Ridge Creamery. Manage project schedules, budgets, resources, risks, issues, and dependencies to ensure successful project delivery.

Intellibright is entering its next phase of growth. Our clients are larger, our programs are more integrated, and the gap between a great strategy and a great result is execution.

About Intellibright

Intellibright is a performance digital marketing agency built around accountability and close client partnerships. Our proprietary revenue analytics connect marketing activity to pipeline, sales, and revenue. If it doesn’t tie back to revenue, it doesn’t matter.

Recognized by the Inc. 5000 and the Financial Times as one of the fastest-growing companies in the Americas five years running, Intellibright is a profitable, self-funded agency headquartered in Austin, Texas, with 16+ years of growth.

What Winning Looks Like

Clients experience Intellibright as organized, proactive, and reliable. Internal teams know exactly what’s expected of them and when. Projects land within budget, and when they’re trending over, you know early and have a plan. Risks surface early, with options attached. Jira reflects reality at all times. End-to-end delivery across a portfolio of client accounts spanning SEO, Local SEO, Paid Search, Paid Social, Organic Social, and Web

Project plans, timelines, dependencies, and resourcing across internal teams and remote contractors

90 days: Every project in your portfolio has a current, accurate plan and budget tracked in Jira; recurring delivery issues are identified and documented with proposed fixes

90 days: Every project in your portfolio has a current, accurate plan and budget tracked in Jira; recurring delivery issues are identified and documented with proposed fixes

new_jobs.description:
As a founding member of our rapidly evolving Project Management team, you will provide end-to-end ownership of complex, high-impact new product development (NPD) programs. You will lead multiple cross-functional teams through the NPD process from concept to retail launch, ensuring projects are delivered on time, on cost, and on spec.

Because our PMO is a newly established function, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our operational standards, creating deep and meaningful partnerships companywide, and demonstrating project management’s strategic value. You serve as a strategic partner, facilitator, and escalation point—driving alignment at leadership levels, navigating high ambiguity, and setting the standard for execution excellence.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities are executed in alignment with PMO standards, methodologies, and the Project Management Competency Matrix. Duties include but are not limited to:

Project & Timeline Management: Own and drive multiple large or complex NPD programs simultaneously through the Phase Gate process. Develop and manage integrated timelines, anticipate delivery risks, and lead cross‑functional teams through trade‑off decisions to protect timing, cost, and scope. This is a leadership role focused on ownership and outcomes, not task execution for other functions. Actively help define and refine our NPD gates and milestones as our PMO matures.
Product & Cross‑Functional Leadership: Partner closely with Product Managers, Marketing, R&D, Engineering, Sourcing, Operations, Quality, and Creative at both working and leadership levels. Facilitate high‑impact meetings, drive decision‑making, and ensure alignment on priorities, commitments, and deliverables across functions.
Advanced Risk Management: Proactively identify, assess, and manage risks across programs with significant business impact. Develop mitigation and contingency plans, escalate appropriately, and prevent late‑stage surprises through early visibility and action.
Stakeholder Communication: Provide clear, concise, and strategic project updates to cross‑functional leaders and stakeholders. Influence alignment and decision‑making by clearly communicating risks, trade‑offs, and recommendations.
Continuous Improvement: Lead efforts to strengthen PMO processes, tools, and standards. Identify systemic gaps across teams and drive improvements that enable more predictable, efficient, and scalable product launches. Help design, pilot, and champion new PMO tools, templates, and communication cadences that make the team more efficient.

Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree required (Business, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, or similar).
Typically 7–10+ years of professional experience, including extensive ownership of complex NPD programs.

Technical Skills

Expert proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and project management tools.

Management Skills

Detail‑Oriented: Manages complex, interdependent project details across multiple programs, anticipating downstream impacts to scope, timing, cost, and quality. Identifies patterns and systemic risks early to prevent escalation and late‑stage disruption.
Communication: Provides clear, concise, and strategic verbal and written communication across all levels of the organization, including senior leadership. Translates complex project dynamics into decision‑ready insights that drive alignment and action.
Problem‑Solving: Anticipates obstacles before they emerge, quickly assesses root causes, and guides teams toward practical, durable solutions that balance business priorities and execution realities.
Cross‑Functional Fluency: Demonstrates deep fluency across Brand, Engineering, Sourcing, Operations, Quality, and other partner functions. Uses this understanding to drive effective collaboration, sound trade‑offs, and strong execution outcomes.
Adaptability & Ambiguity: Thrives in high‑pressure, fast‑changing environments with competing priorities. Leads teams confidently through ambiguity, maintaining momentum and focus despite shifting inputs or incomplete information.

Interpersonal Skills

Mediator, not Participant: Leads as an objective, unbiased truth teller who balances competing functional priorities and interests. Facilitates tough conversations, surfaces hard truths early, and drives fair, informed outcomes aligned to overall business goals.
Conflict Navigation: Navigates complex, high‑stakes conflicts across teams and leadership levels with sound judgment. Resolves competing priorities constructively, escalating appropriately to protect project outcomes.
Calm in the Storm: Maintains composure, clarity, and decisiveness during periods of significant pressure or uncertainty. Sets the tone for teams, helping others remain focused and productive during tight deadlines or critical moments.
Influence Without Authority: Builds strong, trust‑based relationships across the organization and influences outcomes through credibility and expertise. Effectively drives commitment, accountability, and follow‑through without relying on formal authority.
Attention to Detail: Continuously monitors program health at both project and portfolio levels, ensuring small gaps or inconsistencies are identified early and do not scale into larger delivery or quality issues.

Pay And Benefits

US$130,000.00 - US$140,000.00 Annually

Final compensation offered will be determined based on a number of job-related factors, including the candidate’s skills, experience, and qualifications. Employees in this role are eligible to participate in the company’s benefits program, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company matching, accrued vacation, floating holidays, and designated company holidays.
